scope: 16 provisional image-space shell observations and a local projected window-seat edge direction, before user confirmation and any shell reconstruction.

image.camera_type: Perspective side-rear product photograph; not an orthographic side elevation.
image.scale_or_focal_metadata: No visible scale marker; original PNG has no EXIF/focal metadata.

user_sketch.role: Approximate requested shape/section explanation only. Red/green/blue strokes are instructions/sketches, not measured image evidence.
specific_misinterpretations_to_avoid: The red rear-left arc passes over a metal rear-weight boundary; it is not the visible yellow shell boundary.
The green lower line continues behind diagonal webbing; that segment is not an observed yellow/black skirt junction.
The blue window direction is a hand-drawn guide; it does not determine the true 3D window plane angle.

annotation_method.annotator: One AI assistant using visual inspection of original and local grid/crop helpers.
annotation_method.repeat_policy: New r3 image observations; previous r1 coordinate traces were not automatically used as ground truth.
annotation_method.confidence: Relative visual marking confidence, not calibrated probabilities or human study results.
annotation_method.pixel_uncertainty: Conservative marking/edge ambiguity radius; not physical dimensions or manufacturing tolerance.

coordinate_convention.original: Top-left image pixels, x right and y down.
coordinate_convention.normalization_status: RAW_ANNOTATIONS_ONLY. Earlier L737 working normalization removed; only confirmation-controls.json contains the unified L801 proposal.
coordinate_convention.no_3d_interpretation: Visible image anchors, not a closed hidden shell profile.

keypoints_16.feature: Most-posterior visible yellow shell sliver below the rear metal weight
keypoints_16.occlusion_or_inference_note: The yellow/black boundary is visible, but the shell surface continues behind the rear weight and black pad. This is not the full-shell posterior extremum.

keypoints_16.feature: Rear end of visible crown arc above the rear weight
keypoints_16.occlusion_or_inference_note: Rear continuation is covered by metal weight; do not connect P01 to P02 as a measured yellow outline.

keypoints_16.feature: Rear-upper crown arc toward the broad shoulder
Broad crown high region, rear side of the projected maximum
keypoints_16.occlusion_or_inference_note: The crown/handle overlap and highlights make the exact maximum uncertain. This is a 2D observation, not a fixed 3D crown vertex.

keypoints_16.feature: Broad crown high region, front side
keypoints_16.occlusion_or_inference_note: Visible exposed crown edge; it defines a broad region, not a spherical-arc assumption.

keypoints_16.feature: Crown arc descending toward strap buckle
keypoints_16.occlusion_or_inference_note: Visible crown edge, before buckle occlusion.

keypoints_16.feature: Visible crown arc endpoint at strap buckle
keypoints_16.occlusion_or_inference_note: Shell edge disappears beneath buckle/webbing. Hidden continuation is not annotated.

keypoints_16.feature: Yellow front shoulder first visible beyond buckle
keypoints_16.occlusion_or_inference_note: Buckle covers the crown-to-shoulder transition. Do not turn this into a sharp physical notch under the buckle.
Visible local crest behind the front handle/port seat; true 3D extremum not established.

keypoints_16.feature: Upper yellow shell to dark port-seat junction
keypoints_16.occlusion_or_inference_note: Front window-seat attachment is an interface, not the outer metal window-ring silhouette.

keypoints_16.feature: Lower visible upper-port-seat junction before sideblock occlusion
keypoints_16.occlusion_or_inference_note: Main yellow shell continues behind front hardware. This is only the chosen main-shell visible x extent, not complete shell forward extremum.

keypoints_16.feature: First visible lower yellow/black skirt interface after diagonal webbing
keypoints_16.occlusion_or_inference_note: Rear continuation is obscured by webbing; no completed hidden skirt line is inferred.
Visible interface edge, not free-space outer silhouette.
Visible interface edge; separate from black yoke outer silhouette.

keypoints_16.feature: Lowest visible yellow-shell corner before front latch
keypoints_16.occlusion_or_inference_note: Local visible corner is near latch hardware. Hidden continuation toward the window/lower chin is not annotated.

ordered_visible_paths.interpretation: Exposed upper yellow shell arc; stop at buckle and weight occlusion.
Exposed shoulder plus shell/hardware junction, not a complete window plane.
Visible local shell/occluder boundary; isolated observation, no inferred connection to crown.

unobservable_or_not_annotated.reason: Covered by rear metal weight and surrounding hardware; user red line here follows metal edge.

unobservable_or_not_annotated.region: P08 to P09 crown under buckle
Lower rear shell/skirt junction behind diagonal webbing
unobservable_or_not_annotated.reason: User green guide crosses occluder; not a visible material junction.

unobservable_or_not_annotated.region: Front/lower yellow shell behind sideblock, exhaust and window assembly
unobservable_or_not_annotated.reason: Hardware covers actual shell contour; no complete front silhouette is observed.

unobservable_or_not_annotated.region: True shell depth, hidden rear extent and true window-plane angle
unobservable_or_not_annotated.reason: Not uniquely recoverable from this single perspective photograph.

projected_window_edge_direction.edge_identity: Visible upper dark port-seat boundary next to yellow shell, above the sideblock occlusion; selected near-straight local segment. The circular/curved window-ring boundary does not itself define a unique plane direction.
projected_window_edge_direction.fit_model: x_px = a*y_px + b; least-squares over six manual local-edge marks
projected_window_edge_direction.angle_direction: Positive means the observed edge moves to image right as image y increases downward.
projected_window_edge_direction.uncertainty_basis: Manual marking uncertainty, short visible span, local ring curvature, reflections and ambiguous exact seat/ring boundary; not a statistical confidence interval.
do_not_use_as: A known physical side-elevation window tilt

metric_use_limits.IoU: These 16 points/open paths do not define a closed complete-shell mask. Do not compute full-shell silhouette IoU by connecting across hardware occlusion. A visible-yellow-region mask can support a separately labelled visible-region IoU if model rendering uses exactly the same visibility/occluder definition.
metric_use_limits.boundary_error_over_L: Average nearest-boundary deviations may be normalized by the coordinated L, but visible outer arcs and shell/hardware junctions must be reported separately and occluded spans excluded.
metric_use_limits.camera: Camera/geometry ambiguity remains. Do not convert observed 2D residuals directly into true 3D shell displacement.
metric_use_limits.approval_gate: All 16 observations and projected edge angle are provisional pending root/user review; no geometry is authorized by this JSON alone.
